integrity: The proof uses the published exact induced-difference characterization and independently derives a new three-set lower bound. Search noncoverage is not used as proof of novelty. The initiating paper explicitly leaves unbalanced complete multipartite graphs open and highlights K_{1,1,5} as unresolved.
scientific_limitations: The exact formula is proved only for the complete tripartite family with part sizes 1,1,n. It does not determine arbitrary unbalanced complete multipartite graphs. The finite checker covers n=2..5 exhaustively for lower hosts and verifies constructions through n=50; universality rests on the analytic difference-set proof.
title: Exact abelian Cayley host order for the unbalanced family \(K_{1,1,n}\)
